QrGenerator.staticHint: With an open-amount QR, the customer enters the amount.
QrGenerator.directHint: Direct transfer mode: 0% operator fee. Customer pays gas in the native token.
QrGenerator.gasCustomerDesc: Network fee is added on top of the bill (your take is stable across gas spikes).
QrGenerator.gasMerchantDesc: You absorb the network fee. Customer pays only the displayed amount (gas variability is your risk).
QrGenerator.directOptionDesc: Customer pays gas (POL / ETH) themselves; the operator fee is skipped and a plain ERC20 transfer is sent.
QrGenerator.splitDescription: Distribute up to {max} additional recipients by %; primary keeps the remainder. Sent as a single batched UserOperation.

splitError.sum: Total percent ≥ 100 (no share left for primary)
splitError.dup: Duplicate address (same as primary, or within split)

QrGenerator.qrDescription: Scanning the QR opens the payment page.

PaymentForm.title: OpenPay Payment
PaymentForm.directWarningBody: This QR is in direct transfer mode. You need {nativeToken} (native gas token) in your wallet. The merchant receives the full amount with no operator fee.
PaymentForm.merchantGasHint: Merchant absorbs the network fee. You pay only the displayed amount.
PaymentForm.directBatchHint: Sends a single ERC20 transfer directly. Smart Account / Pimlico Paymaster is not used.
PaymentForm.gaslessBatchHintJpyc: Network fee is collected in JPYC (operator settles POL gas with Pimlico off-chain). You don't need to hold native tokens (POL).
PaymentForm.gaslessBatchHintUsdc: You pay the network fee in USDC (via Pimlico ERC20 Paymaster). No need to hold native tokens (ETH). The figure shown is an upper-bound estimate; surplus is not charged.
PaymentForm.splitBatchHint: Gas is covered by the operator (Pimlico Sponsorship Paymaster). {count} transfers are batched in a single UserOperation.
PaymentForm.errorGasCongested: The network is congested and gas prices are too high. Please try again later.
PaymentForm.errorGasQuote: Failed to fetch the gas estimate. Check your network connection and try again.
PaymentForm.errorMerchantUnderflow: After deducting fees the merchant would receive 0. Minimum {min} required.
